analysis:
The PR adds provider-local selected-model recovery. The changes are scheduling and residency logic. They do not touch crypto, attestation, auth or cache-storage code.

Changes examined:
(1) ProviderLoop+Autopilot.swift head:213 calls noteSelectedModelUnloaded after each successful victim unload. This happens inside the existing ownership and cancellation checks.
(2) ProviderLoop+AutopilotBusy.swift head:22 treats an active selectedModelRecovery.attempt as a preload busy reason. This makes coordinator autopilot commands get rejected with provider_busy, which is fail-closed.
(3) ProviderLoop+AutopilotControl.swift head:76 caches config.backend.enabledModels into savedEnabledModels on every settings refresh. The source is the operator's own config file (TB-003 operator is the trusted owner of local config).
(4) New ProviderLoop+SelectedModelPlacementPolicy.swift:
- adoptionReleaseTime (head:22-34) returns nil for protected, invalid, held or non-serving cases.
- Release is never before 600s, minimum dwell or lease.
- releaseAdoptionForSelectedModelRecovery (head:39-52) removes the adoption, withdraws models, bumps the generation and sends a heartbeat. In-flight requests finish.
(5) ProviderLoop+Capacity.swift head:82 calls checkSelectedModelRecoveryIfDue on each capacity refresh.

Threat relevance:
- A-018 (serving availability) and the A-001/T-008 plaintext paths are unaffected. In-flight requests are not cancelled.
- The coordinator still learns of withdrawal through the snapshot and heartbeat. The comment at Autopilot.swift:242 says the coordinator must reconcile the pair.
- TB-012/T-059 add-on hold: addonHold remains a separate busy reason. Recovery is not shown to load models during a hold.

Integration must check the unseen ProviderLoop+SelectedModelRecovery.swift:
- checkSelectedModelRecoveryIfDue, noteSelectedModelUnloaded and isProtectedFromRecoveryEviction.
- Whether recovery loads respect addonHoldActive, isDraining/isShuttingDown and autopilotCommand ownership (checkAutopilotLoadOwnership).
- Whether recovery honors the privateOnly/consent gates.
- Whether withdrawn adoptions refuse new requests via autopilotAllowsModel (AutopilotControl.swift:48-57).
- Whether repeated capacity refreshes can cause a load/evict churn loop, a DoS on A-018.

No regression is identified in the supplied lines.
